about: System administrator who keeps infrastructure quiet, secure, and well-documented so teams can focus on their work. I like automating the dull, repetitive tasks and building monitoring that catches problems before users notice.

experiences.description: Maintain and harden internal servers, networking, and identity systems across the organisation. I automated patching and backup verification, which cut manual effort and improved recovery confidence.

Operated hosting infrastructure for several client environments, owning provisioning and incident response. I built monitoring dashboards that shortened detection and resolution times for recurring faults.
Supported end-user systems and shared services, balancing helpdesk demand with planned maintenance. I standardised workstation configuration, which reduced onboarding time for new staff.
Assisted with server maintenance, user account management, and routine backups under senior supervision. I documented common procedures so the team could resolve repeat issues faster.
Handled first-line support for hardware, software, and connectivity issues across the office. I learned the fundamentals of system administration while keeping daily operations running smoothly.

projects.title: Learning and Logistics Test Harness
projects.summary: Acted as software tester on a platform spanning online learning and supply chain coordination. I designed and ran test cases across both modules, catching integration defects where course scheduling met inventory workflows.

projects.title: AI Services Provisioning Platform
projects.summary: Served as system administrator for a platform delivering AI-driven ICT services to internal teams. I managed the runtime environments, automated deployments, and kept the supporting infrastructure stable under variable demand.
